name: Bajju
description: The Bajju people are known for farming, vibrant cloth weaving, and the annual Afan yam festival.

name: Atyap
description: The Atyap community around Zangon Kataf preserves music, dance, and local history through storytelling.

name: Agworok (Kagoro)
description: Agworok people live near the Kagoro Hills and are known for their craft, communal ceremonies, and hillside farming.

name: Irigwe
description: The Irigwe people blend storytelling, carving, and farming traditions in a region rich with community ritual.

name: kamanton
description: The kamanton people are known for their unique cultural practices and traditional crafts.

name: Ham (Jaba)
description: The Ham people, found in Jaba, are known for their rich history, the Tuk Ham festival, and intricate pottery.

name: Gbagyi (Gwari)
description: Known for their resilience and farming prowess, the Gbagyi people have a unique tradition of carrying loads on their shoulders.

name: Adara
description: The Adara people are a prominent group with a rich cultural heritage, known for their farming and community values.
